name: Four Seasons Hotel Singapore
insider_take: This urban oasis sits atop the buzzing Orchard Road shopping district, offering a tranquil escape 20 floors above Singapore's retail heartbeat.
whats_special: The hotel features Singapore's highest outdoor pool at 20 stories up, plus it's built directly above the ION Orchard mall - you can shop luxury brands without stepping outside. The property also houses one of only a few Joel Robuchon restaurants in Southeast Asia.
pro_tip: Book a city-view room on floors 25+ for stunning vistas of the Singapore skyline and Marina Bay, especially magical at sunset when the city lights begin to twinkle.
dont_miss: The infinity pool experience with panoramic city views, and take the direct elevator access to ION Sky observation deck on the 56th floor for 360-degree views of Singapore - it's complimentary for hotel guests.
pros: Prime Orchard Road location with luxury shopping access
Exceptional Four Seasons service standards and hospitality
Multiple award-winning dining venues and culinary experiences
Spacious rooms and suites with elegant contemporary design
